answer: Verified-history handoff. Each agent identity must inherit a signed interaction ledger from a prior identity, and the ledger's oldest entry must trace to a physical anchor site (oasis, shale, copper) whose sensor logs confirm continuous presence over 90 days. New identities without a valid handoff chain get zero routing priority. An attacker must physically maintain distinct anchor sites and forge 90 days of corroborating sensor logs per identity—roughly 2,000 hours of site labor—before gaining any standing.
